paragraphs.text: Mount Kireshal was a high peak in the Karplusan Mountains on the continent of Terisiare at the time of the Dominarian Ice Age .
Mount Kireshal was located above Balesh Pass , a two-days walk through the snow from Mount Delapre . High in the mountains, the peak was snow-covered even after the end of the Ice Age .

Before the second battle of Balesh Pass , the Balduvian orc general Groth Jonar met with his two clan chiefs, Jel and Lavash on the peak of Kireshal. Sharing a rare meal of chicken, Groth convinced the two chiefs to accept goblins of the Flarg into their ranks, sharing only that he had a very specific plan for these irregular troops.
